title: Le Figaro Journalism Comes to ChatGPT! 📰
body: Le Figaro Journalism Comes to ChatGPT! 📰

On November 18, OpenAI and the French newspaper Le Figaro announced a strategic partnership that makes Le Figaro's journalism discoverable inside ChatGPT. When you ask ChatGPT about a news story, it may show you a summary or excerpt from Le Figaro articles, current and archived, with a link to the original article on the newspaper's website, covering news, business, culture, and lifestyle.
The newspaper, which employs more than 600 journalists, retains full editorial independence, and also plans to use ChatGPT Enterprise — the business version of the assistant — within its teams.
The partnership gives journalism a new distribution channel through AI, without giving up editorial decisions.
Do you trust the news summaries that AI provides? 🧐
